request: When loading an ancestor folder, independently check for version-control metadata in both setup phases instead of carrying the first answer forward, so our tracing can show each phase doing its own discovery.

source.request: When loading an ancestor folder, independently check for version-control metadata in both setup phases instead of carrying the first answer forward, so our tracing can show each phase doing its own discovery.
source.settled: Loading an absolute parent reuses its initial repository-marker detection instead of checking the same markers twice.
source.why: Independent discovery in both phases reinstates the duplicate metadata checks the ticket removed.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored.
